articles.title: Blue Chrome
articles.summary: Full mirror chrome with a cool tinted cast; bright reflective surface with fine flake and strong highlight streaks. On a car it should read as a mirror-polished tinted chrome that reflects the sky and track, with only the faintest diagonal micro-grain; the swatch itself looks like a quiet grey-violet sheet.
articles.what: Cool blue-tinted mirror chrome — full reflectivity with an icy sapphire hue over the chrome surface Up close: Very fine diagonal pinstripe grain, about 4 to 5 px apart, alternating faint green-teal and lilac lines over a flat mid-grey neutral, plus a few tiny pale specks. In this flat swatch the true mirror reflection cannot show; the data says full metal, very smooth, near-max clearcoat. From a distance: On a car it should read as a mirror-polished tinted chrome that reflects the sky and track, with only the faintest diagonal micro-grain; the swatch itself looks like a quiet grey-violet sheet. Measured spec (average): metal 221, roughness 35, coat 17. Shine: high gloss. Metal: full. It takes the colour you give the zone.
when: Best on: body, trim, hero panel.
Fits: show car, gt / sports car, open wheel.
how: This finish is not listed in the Base Material picker, so you cannot pick it there.
Open the AI copilot (the ✦ AI button, bottom right) and ask for it by name, for example "put Blue Chrome on the hood".
Pick your colour with BASE COLOR.
Render and judge it on the car, not on the swatch.
tips: Hood, roof and sides: big curved panels give the best reflections
Pair with matte black lower body, tires and splitters to frame it
Mirror reflections confuse numbers; use matte black or solid white numbers on a flat plate.
Thin black or white pinstripes: crisp graphic lines on a mirror
Pairs well with: white, silver, matte black, chrome.
Not listed in the picker: ask the AI copilot for it by name.
pitfalls: Not blue paint with metallic flake: it is a mirror, brightness comes from reflections
Not brushed metal: roughness is low and the grain is almost invisible
Avoid: next to other loud reflective finishes, small text over heavy reflection.
articles.spec_character: Average spec: metal 221 (true metallic), roughness 35 (high gloss), clearcoat 17 (very strong clearcoat).
articles.intent_note: Full-finish shelf: the finish carries both its own paint look and its own shine.
articles.paint_advice: Metal takes on the paint colour: light and mid colours keep the sparkle, very dark colours swallow it. Avoid: next to other loud reflective finishes, small text over heavy reflection.

combos.why: Patterns that suit it: thin black or white pinstripes: crisp graphic lines on a mirror; matte black stripes and blocks: strong contrast with the mirror
Patterns to avoid: busy camo or noise: dirties the mirror and wastes the reflection; fine weave or carbon: competes with the micro-grain
Spec overlays that work: matte spec stripes or logos: dull blocks on mirror, high contrast; fine brushed lines: a satin-chrome zone next to mirror zone
Judge the paint and the shine together: the same spec looks different under different colours.
